2727312.variantName: Argos Home Animated Gazing Reindeer Christmas Decoration
2727312.sourceDescription: Bring a little magic to your Christmas display with this animated gazing reindeer decoration. It's lit with rope LEDs and features a gently nodding head that brings movement and charm to your garden or indoor space. You're getting a fully animated metal figure that creates a festive focal point and captures the wonder of the season. The timer feature makes it easy to set your display to come on and off automatically, so you can enjoy the gentle glow without thinking about it. With 216 LED bulbs included and mains power, it's ready to brighten your festive setup right out of the box. Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, it's a flexible decoration that works wherever you need that seasonal sparkle. . A fantastic seasonal outdoor decoration that everyone will love. . Size H89, W82, D43cm.; Suitable for indoor and outdoor use.; Animated.; Timer feature.; 12 Watts.; Requires 216 x LED bulbs (included).; Mains powered.; Self-assembly.; Made from metal.; Manufacturer's 2 year guarantee.

qh7r280e.variantName: Walplus Artificial Christmas Tree 76 cm Wide - Green - 180 cm
qh7r280e.sourceDescription: This lovely and lifelike artificial Christmas tree with distinctive tips will become the focal point of your holiday decorations. Hinged construction: This luxury tree has a hinged construction, so the branches will automatically fold down in the right angle. This will make it much easier to put up the tree in the perfect shape, and will save you time as well.Bushy Christmas tree: The Christmas tree is designed with a lot of beautiful PVC tips, giving the tree a beautiful realistic look along with a bushy appearance.Sturdy stand: The artificial tree is made of a sturdy steel stand, which provides the tree with optimal stability.Beautiful decoration: The Christmas tree even comes with cones on it, offering a wonderful natural effect. It is decorated with artificial white snow and glitter to create a unique wintery feel.Lasting durability: The Xmas tree can be used again every year, making it a very economical choice compared to a real tree. Note:Each product comes with an assembly manual in the box for easy assembly. Product Specifications Colour: Green and white Material: PVC, steel Tree height: 180 cm Maximum tree width: 76 cm Base diameter: 45 cm With hinged construction Features white snow and glitter decoration With 34 cones With 327 pointed tips and 282 round tips Delivery contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

t0bhvt3h.baseName: Neo Christmas Tree Stand for Real Trees - Green
t0bhvt3h.variantName: Neo Christmas Tree Stand for Real Trees - Green
t0bhvt3h.sourceDescription: Keep your real Christmas tree securely supported throughout the festive season with the Neo Extra Large Christmas Tree Stand. Designed for trees up to 2.5m (8ft 2in) tall, this sturdy stand combines a wide base with four steel legs to provide reliable support for your Christmas display. The green plastic reservoir is complemented by contrasting red steel legs for a traditional festive appearance. Four adjustable securing screws hold the tree trunk firmly in position and accommodate trunk diameters from 5cm to 14cm, making it suitable for a variety of real Christmas trees. A built-in 3.3L water reservoir allows the tree trunk to remain in water, helping you maintain your real tree throughout the Christmas period. The wide 57cm base provides additional stability while remaining compact enough for use in living rooms, conservatories and other indoor festive displays. Extra-large stand for real Christmas trees Suitable for trees up to 2.5m (8ft 2in) tall Accommodates tree trunks from 5cm to 14cm in diameter Four adjustable screws securely hold the trunk in position Four sturdy steel legs provide a wide, stable base Green plastic reservoir with contrasting red legs Built-in 3.3L water reservoir Allows the tree trunk to remain in water Suitable for indoor Christmas displays Quick and straightforward assembly Product Dimensions: H21.5 x W57 x D57cm Maximum Tree Height: 2.5m Maximum Trunk Diameter: 14cm Minimum Trunk Diameter: 5cm Water Capacity: 3.3L For use with real Christmas trees only. Adult assembly and installation required. Place the stand on a firm, level and stable surface and ensure all four legs are correctly fitted before inserting the tree. Suitable for trees up to 2.5m tall with a trunk diameter between 5cm and 14cm. Centre the trunk within the stand and tighten all securing screws evenly to ensure the tree remains upright and stable. Do not exceed the specified maximum tree height or trunk diameter. Regularly check the screws and stability of the tree throughout use and retighten if necessary. Keep the water reservoir adequately filled but do not overfill; wipe up spills immediately to prevent slip hazards and protect surrounding flooring. Keep the tree and stand away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, heaters and other direct heat sources. Do not allow children or pets to climb, pull or lean against the tree or stand. Take care when handling the metal legs and screws and discontinue use if any component becomes bent, damaged, loose or unstable. Keep small parts and packaging materials away from children. Neo Direct Ltd, Butterley Street, Leeds, LS10 1AW, United Kingdom

sz6d5tm1.sourceDescription: Create a festive focal point around your Christmas tree with this pre-lit wooden tree skirt featuring a charming Northern Lights Bear scene. The natural brown surround showcases decorative cut-out details illuminated by multicolour RGB LED lights. Choose from a range of lighting effects using the included remote control or the cable-mounted button. Designed for easy assembly, the panels slot together around your tree before or after decorating. Suitable for most 6ft to 8ft Christmas trees, it accommodates tree stands up to 78cm diagonally, depending on stand shape. Powered by a low-voltage mains transformer for indoor use only.
